# Monocypher 4.0.2

Ed25519 (RFC 8032) for `felitronics::appkit_licence` (`include/felitronics/appkit/LicenceKey.h`). Dual-licensed
BSD-2-Clause or CC0-1.0, see `LICENCE.md`.

The files are the release tarball's, unchanged: https://monocypher.org/download/monocypher-4.0.2.tar.gz
(sha256 `38d07179738c0c90677dba3ceb7a7b8496bcfea758ba1a53e803fed30ae0879c`). They match the repository's tag 4.0.2
(https://github.com/LoupVaillant/Monocypher, commit 0d85f98c9d9b0227e42cf795cb527dff372b40a4) except for the version
stamp on each file's first line.
